_what: Metrics the contract 108 write schema serves (the REPORT column metric enum, data/derived/condition_vocabulary_108.json reportColumn.metric) that the 61.2.0 metric extraction never measured. Known NAMES only: which transforms each composes, its native output kind, timeframe mode, header code and vocabulary are UNMEASURED offline - at 61.2.0 they were read live (get_metric_construction_hints per metric, then get_strategy_column_contract / preview_strategy_report probes; data/contract/_manifest.json toolsUsed, scripts/refresh_metric_contracts.py). omega.validate refuses a column over one (METRIC_UNMEASURED) and the generator never selects one, so no generated plan emits them until a re-extraction moves them into data/contract/metrics/<METRIC>.json. scripts/compare_vocabulary.py counts them as stored (so a served metric omega knows by name is not 'missing'), and lists them under storedUnmeasured.
